title: 服务器性能

sources.command: read _ u n s i w q sq _ < /proc/stat; set -- $(free -b | awk 'NR==2{print $2, $7}'); mt=$1; ma=$2; set -- $(df -B1 / | awk 'NR==2{print $2, $3}'); dt=$1; du=$2; read l1 l5 l15 _ < /proc/loadavg; read up _ < /proc/uptime; printf '{"cpu":[%s,%s],"mem":[%s,%s],"disk":[%s,%s],"load":[%s,%s,%s],"cores":%s,"uptime":%s}' $((u+n+s+q+sq)) $((u+n+s+i+w+q+sq)) $mt $ma $dt $du $l1 $l5 $l15 $(nproc) $up

html: CPU —
